node.statement: Dependency-bearing bridge for the combination: this step depends on nodes 1.3 and 1.4 and requires both to be validated. Let A = sum_{j=1}^m c_j ||p_j - r_j||_1 + (1 - s)||q - r||_1. Node 1.3 gives D <= ||p - r_star||_1 <= A, hence D <= A. Node 1.4 gives A <= s D + (1 - s)d. By transitivity of <=, D <= s D + (1 - s)d.
